name: Same-wing rook ending (4v3 family)

plans.label: King before rook
plans.description: Improve the king while the rook already owns the open file.

success.note: Holding is an outcome and has no structural signature here.

plans.label: Trade pawns, not rooks
plans.description: Every pawn trade shortens the defence; keep the rook that makes it holdable.

success.note: Pawn-count progress is outside this vocabulary.

plans.label: Sixth-rank restraint
plans.description: Use the rook to restrain the opposing king before seeking activity.

success.note: Holding is an outcome and has no structural signature here.

plans.label: Active second rank
plans.description: Seek counterplay against the pawns while keeping the rook active.

success.note: Activity quality is not rules arithmetic.

plans.label: King up, pawns forward
plans.description: Bring the king toward the pawns before fixing their advances.

success.note: Conversion is an outcome and has no structural signature here.

plans.label: Offer rook trades
plans.description: Use rook exchanges to convert the extra pawn when the resulting pawn ending works.

success.note: Whether the pawn ending works is not expressed by this vocabulary.
